description: Find programs across institutions, ranked and filtered by completion-based one-year median earnings within the fetched school page. Legacy highest-credential values remain separate with their own provenance. Earnings and debt pool across campuses sharing OPEID6 within CIP/credential; awards are campus-specific. School page/per_page/total count schools; limit/offset page the matching program rows. Follow next to drain this school page before advancing to the next school page. Use scorecard_lookup_cip to find CIP codes.

cip_code.description: CIP 4-digit code to search for (e.g. "11.07" for Computer Science). Use scorecard_lookup_cip to find codes.

credential_level.description: Provider credential selector: 1=undergraduate certificate, 2=associate, 3=bachelor, 4=post-baccalaureate certificate, 5=master, 6=doctoral, 7=first professional, 8=graduate/professional certificate, 99=non-credential; other integer levels may return no matches.

limit.description: Program rows per response; values above 100 normalize to 100.

max_debt.description: Maximum median cumulative Stafford/Grad PLUS debt across institutions at the same academic level, inclusive; excludes unavailable debt.

max_net_price.description: Maximum average net price at the school.

min_earnings.description: Minimum completion-based one-year median earnings, inclusive, without legacy fallback; filters this school page locally while school totals remain unchanged.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset within the filtered and sorted school page.

per_page.description: Schools per page (max 100); program rows may exceed this count.

program_name.description: Case-insensitive title substring matched within the fetched school page. Ignored when cip_code is provided; use cip_code for upstream program matching.

state.description: Comma-separated two-letter state codes; case and whitespace normalized, blanks unset.

name: scorecard_search_programs

cap.description: The effective program row limit that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_conflict`: The provider reported a request conflict. `api_invalid_params`: Provider rejected a query parameter. `api_validation`: A meaningful selector or provider value is invalid. `api_unauthorized`: The provider rejected the API credentials. `api_forbidden`: The provider denied access. `api_rate_limited`: The provider throttled the request. `api_timeout`: The provider exchange exceeded its deadline. `api_not_found`: The provider endpoint returned HTTP 404. `api_invalid_request`: The provider returned an unexpected redirect. `api_internal`: The provider returned an unclassified HTTP response. `api_error`: The College Scorecard API returned an error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limit.description: Effective program row limit, at most 100.

metric_scope.description: Aggregation scope within CIP and credential identity.

debt.description: Debt pools across campuses sharing OPEID6.

earnings.description: Earnings pool across campuses sharing OPEID6.

program_identity.description: Program dimensions retained within each pooled group.

offset.description: Row offset to request on that school page.

next.description: Continuation using the same selectors and limits; null when exhausted.

nextOffset.description: Next row offset on this school page, or null when drained.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no programs match or earnings data is unavailable.

offset.description: Effective zero-based row offset within this school page.

programs.description: One page of program rows retaining credential identities, stably sorted by completion-based one-year earnings descending, with unavailable current earnings last.

completion_1yr_availability.description: Availability of completion-based one-year median earnings.

completion_1yr_count.description: Working and not enrolled completers in the one-year earnings population.

completion_1yr_count_availability.description: Availability of the matching one-year population count.

completion_1yr_median.description: Median earnings one year after completion, in the stated dollar year.

completion_4yr_availability.description: Availability of completion-based four-year median earnings.

completion_4yr_count.description: Working and not enrolled completers in the four-year earnings population.

completion_4yr_count_availability.description: Availability of the matching four-year population count.

completion_4yr_median.description: Median earnings four years after completion, in the stated dollar year.

credential_level.description: Provider credential level; unknown future numeric levels are retained.

earnings_1yr_median.description: Median earnings of graduates working and not enrolled 1 year after their highest credential.

earnings_availability.description: Available number, unavailable with unknown cause, or confirmed privacy suppression.

earnings_count_availability.description: Availability of the legacy highest-credential count.

ipeds_awards_year1.description: IPEDS awards in year 1 of the pooled debt cohort; awards, not enrollment or unique students.

ipeds_awards_year2.description: IPEDS awards in year 2 of the pooled debt cohort; awards, not enrollment or unique students.

median_debt.description: Median cumulative Stafford/Grad PLUS borrowing among completers across attended institutions at the same academic level.

net_price_overall.description: Average net price at this school.

ope6_id.description: Provider OPEID6 group identifier, preserving leading zeros; null when absent.

school_id.description: School unit ID — use for follow-up calls.

school_ownership.description: Control type: Public, Private nonprofit, or For-profit.

suppressed.description: True only for explicit provider privacy markers.

provenance.description: Dictionary provenance for each distinct program population.

query.description: Normalized effective selectors and pagination defaults.

schools_shown.description: Schools returned on this school page.

shown.description: Program rows returned in this response.

suppressed_count.description: Matching programs with confirmed privacy-suppressed legacy highest-credential earnings, before row paging.

total.description: Total schools matching upstream filters, before pagination and local program filtering.

totalCount.description: Total schools matching upstream filters, before pagination and local program filtering.

total_programs.description: Matching program rows on the fetched school page before row pagination.

truncated.description: True when more program rows or a later school page remain.

unavailable_count.description: Matching programs with unavailable legacy highest-credential earnings of unknown cause, before row paging.
